draft.text: You came in because your blood sugar levels are not under control.
You also wanted to talk about the pain and tingling in your legs and feet.
Your A1C level was 9.9, which shows your blood sugar has been high over the past few months.
You have ongoing symptoms like burning or aching in your legs and feet, and you have trouble feeling your toes.
These symptoms may be related to diabetic neuropathy, which is nerve damage caused by diabetes.
You will be asked to check your blood sugar more often and to report any changes in how you feel.

unverified_summary.text: You came for a check-up because your blood sugar levels have been hard to control.
Your A1C level was 9.9, which shows your blood sugar has been high.
You also have burning or aching pain in your legs and feet, and you feel less sensation in your toes.
These symptoms may be related to diabetic neuropathy, which is nerve damage caused by diabetes.
We will talk about adjusting your medication and refer you for tests to check your nerves and other possible issues.
